**Considering black and white animals**

I'm trying to infer which animals are black and white and can tolerate cold, rain, and snow. I think of polar bears, which are primarily white but have black noses and live in the Arctic. Penguins also come to mind; they're definitely black and white and thrive in cold environments. Another option could be a skunk. Based on these clues, it seems polar bears and penguins are the strongest candidates!
